rules.mechanism: Sanctions can restrict FX inflows and access to reserves, pressuring the rouble.

rules.mechanism: Tariffs are paid by US importers, raising the landed cost of affected goods.

conditions.note: Exporter price cuts and currency moves can absorb part of the tariff.

rules.rationale: Tariff incidence studies of the 2018-19 US-China tariffs found substantial pass-through to US import prices.

rules.mechanism: Retailers absorbing higher import costs see gross-margin pressure.

conditions.note: Pricing power and supplier diversification can offset.
